# Waterproofed.com

> Waterproofed.com is the online presence of Southern California Decking, Inc., a waterproofing and deck coating contractor serving Los Angeles, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Pasadena, Malibu, Orange County, and surrounding Southern California communities. The company specializes in waterproofing systems for decks, balconies, planters, roof decks, pool decks, stairs, and specialty flooring surfaces.

For more than 38 years, Waterproofed.com has provided waterproofing, deck coating, restoration, repair, and floor leveling services for homeowners, HOAs, apartment complexes, commercial properties, schools, and property managers throughout Southern California. The company focuses on long-term protection against water intrusion, structural damage, mold, and surface deterioration. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

## Core Services

- Deck Waterproofing
  https://www.waterproofed.com/
  Protection against leaks, cracking, weather damage, and surface deterioration for residential and commercial decks.

- Balcony Waterproofing
  https://www.waterproofed.com/services/balcony-waterproofing-coating-repair
  Waterproof membrane systems and coatings for balconies, apartments, condominiums, and HOA properties.

- Planter Waterproofing & Repair
  https://www.waterproofed.com/services/planter-waterproofing-coating-repair
  Leak prevention, membrane installation, flashing repairs, and planter restoration.

- Roof Deck Waterproofing
  https://www.waterproofed.com/
  Waterproofing systems designed to protect elevated outdoor living spaces from water intrusion and UV exposure.

- Pool Deck Waterproofing
  https://www.waterproofed.com/
  Slip-resistant waterproof coatings and moisture protection for pool environments.

- Stair Waterproofing
  https://www.waterproofed.com/
  Waterproofing and protective coatings for exterior stair systems.

- Floor Leveling
  https://www.waterproofed.com/services/Professional-Concrete-Floor-Leveling
  Concrete and wood floor leveling solutions for residential and commercial properties.
